mentions.name: aweb.ai
mentions.description: Agent communication platform that gives AI agents verifiable identities and tools to talk to each other and share tasks directly, replacing manual copy/pasting between agents. Identities are public-key DIDs with DNS as the source of truth, including team membership. Open source.
mentions.problem: The author was tired of copying/pasting between AI agents, which could not otherwise communicate or share tasks.
mentions.source_excerpt:
